css:
/* ============================================================
   Sydney Hot Water Systems - home page design system v3
   Direction: bold trade editorial. Full-bleed dark hero,
   oversized uppercase display type, pill actions with arrow
   badges, large soft-radius panels, dark diagonal bands.
   Brand colours from the logo: navy #20386e, red #cb4236.
   ============================================================ */
@font-face{font-family:"Jost";font-style:normal;font-weight:400 700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Montserrat";font-style:normal;font-weight:400 700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --navy:#20386e; --navy-900:#0d1426; --navy-800:#121c33; --navy-700:#1a2b55;
  --navy-600:#2b4a8c; --navy-400:#5f7cb8; --navy-300:#93a8d2; --navy-50:#eef2f9;
  --red:#cb4236; --red-700:#a3332a; --red-600:#b93a2f; --red-300:#e8776c; --red-50:#fdefed;
  --ink:#101728; --body:#5f6877; --muted:#7a8496;
  --line:#e5e9f1; --line-2:#ccd4e2; --line-dark:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --paper:#ffffff; --paper-2:#f5f7fb; --paper-3:#eef2f8;
  --d-ink:#ffffff; --d-body:#c4d0e6; --d-muted:#8e9cba;
  --r-xs:6px; --r-sm:10px; --r:16px; --r-card:22px; --r-lg:32px; --r-xl:46px; --r-pill:999px;
  --sh-1:0 2px 4px rgba(13,20,38,.04);
  --sh-2:0 18px 44px -20px rgba(13,20,38,.3);
  --sh-3:0 40px 90px -34px rgba(13,20,38,.5);
  --gut:clamp(18px,4.4vw,52px);
  --band:clamp(62px,8vw,124px);
  --band-sm:clamp(46px,5.4vw,84px);
  --maxw:1320px;
  --ff-head:"Jost","Jost Fallback","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,Arial,sans-serif;
  --ff-body:"Montserrat","Montserrat Fallback","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,Arial,sans-serif;
  --t:.24s; --t-slow:.55s; --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,.16,.2,1);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--body);font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.72;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--ff-head);color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 .5em;font-weight:500}
h1,h2{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.004em}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.05rem,3.75vw,3.25rem);line-height:1.12;font-weight:500}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.85rem,3.5vw,3.05rem);line-height:1.14}
h3{font-size:clamp(1.08rem,1.4vw,1.28rem);line-height:1.36;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0}
p{margin:0 0 1.1em}
a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:3px}
a:hover{color:var(--red-700)}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
ul{margin:0 0 1.1em;padding-left:1.15em}
li{margin-bottom:.5em}
strong{color:var(--ink)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:var(--r-xs)}
.sprite{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden}
.ic{width:1.05em;height:1.05em;flex:none;fill:currentColor}
.ic-md{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;fill:currentColor}
.ic-lg{width:24px;height:24px;flex:none;fill:currentColor}
.wrap{width:100%;max-width:var(--maxw);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gut)}
.band{padding-block:var(--band)}
.band-sm{padding-block:var(--band-sm)}
.lede{font-size:clamp(1.02rem,1.25vw,1.14rem);color:var(--body);max-width:62ch}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;margin:-1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;z-index:200;border-radius:0 0 var(--r-sm) 0}
.skip:focus{left:0}
section[id]{scroll-margin-top:104px}

/* ---------- eyebrow + section heads ---------- */
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 1.05rem}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 0 3.6px,#000 3.6px);
  mask:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 0 3.6px,#000 3.6px);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 99px var(--red)}
.sec-head{margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,62px);max-width:74ch}
.sec-head .lede{margin-bottom:0}
.sec-head h2{margin-bottom:0}
.sec-head h2+.lede{margin-top:1.1rem}
.sec-head.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:clamp(24px,3.4vw,64px);align-items:end;max-width:none}
.sec-head.split h2{margin-bottom:0}
.sec-head.split .eyebrow{grid-column:1/-1}
.sec-head.split .lede{margin:0;padding-bottom:.45rem}
.sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center;max-width:62ch}
.sec-head.center .eyebrow{justify-content:center}
.sec-head.center .lede{margin-inline:auto}

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.7em;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.015em;padding:14px 22px 14px 28px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;min-height:58px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),border-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease),transform var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease)}
.btn .ic{position:relative;z-index:1}
.btn>span{position:relative;z-index:1}
.btn .bdg{position:relative;z-index:1;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;margin-left:.1em;transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease),background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.btn .bdg svg{width:13px;height:13px;fill:currentColor}
.btn:hover .bdg{transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 12px 26px -12px rgba(203,66,54,.85)}
.btn-primary .bdg{background:#fff;color:var(--red)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--red-700);border-color:var(--red-700);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 34px -14px rgba(203,66,54,.9)}
.btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy .bdg{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy:hover{background:var(--navy-700);border-color:var(--navy-700);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.btn-ghost .bdg{background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy)}
.btn-onDark{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.42)}
.btn-onDark .bdg{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}
.btn-onDark:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy-900);border-color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-onDark:hover .bdg{background:var(--navy-900);color:#fff}
.btn-sm{padding:10px 16px 10px 20px;font-size:.88rem;min-height:46px;gap:.5em}
.btn-sm .bdg{width:26px;height:26px}
.btn-sm .bdg svg{width:11px;height:11px}

/* ---------- utility bar ---------- */
.utility{background:var(--navy-900);color:var(--d-body);font-size:.84rem;position:relative;z-index:3}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:-54px;z-index:60;background:transparent}
.site-header::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 34px -20px rgba(13,20,38,.6);opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--t) var(--ease);pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.site-header.is-stuck::after,.site-header.menu-open::after{opacity:1}
.hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;justify-content:space-between;padding-block:15px;position:relative}
.hdr::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:var(--gut);right:var(--gut);bottom:0;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);transition:opacity var(--t) var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck .hdr::after,.site-header.menu-open .hdr::after{opacity:0}
.hdr>*{min-width:0}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex:none;min-width:0}
.brand img{width:184px;max-width:46vw;background:#fff;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),padding var(--t) var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck .brand img,.site-header.menu-open .brand img{background:transparent;padding:0}
.nav-main{margin-left:auto;flex:0 0 auto}
.nav-list{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;flex-wrap:nowrap}
.nav-list li{margin:0;position:relative}
.nav-list>li>a,.nav-toggle-sub{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.34em;white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:500;font-size:.96rem;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-xs);background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck .nav-list>li>a,.site-header.is-stuck .nav-toggle-sub,.site-header.menu-open .nav-list>li>a{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-list>li>a::after,.nav-toggle-sub::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:4px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--red);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease)}
.nav-list>li>a:hover,.nav-toggle-sub:hover,.nav-toggle-sub[aria-expanded="true"]{color:#fff}
.site-header.is-stuck .nav-list>li>a:hover,.site-header.is-stuck .nav-toggle-sub:hover,.site-header.is-stuck .nav-toggle-sub[aria-expanded="true"]{color:var(--navy)}
.nav-list>li>a:hover::after,.nav-toggle-sub:hover::after,.nav-toggle-sub[aria-expanded="true"]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.nav-toggle-sub .ic{transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease)}
.nav-toggle-sub[aria-expanded="true"] .ic{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.subnav{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 12px);left:0;min-width:306px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);box-shadow:var(--sh-3);padding:10px;margin:0;list-style:none;display:none;z-index:70}
.subnav.open{display:block}
.subnav a{display:block;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:var(--r);font-size:.94rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--ff-head);transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.subnav a span{display:block;font-family:var(--ff-body);font-weight:400;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.45}
.subnav a:hover{background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy)}
.subnav a:hover span{color:var(--body)}
.hdr-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:none}
.hdr-cta .btn{white-space:nowrap}
.burger,.call-icon{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:50px;height:50px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-radius:var(--r);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease),border-color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck .burger,.site-header.is-stuck .call-icon,.site-header.menu-open .burger,.site-header.menu-open .call-icon{border-color:var(--line-2);color:var(--navy)}
.burger:hover,.call-icon:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}
.mobile-panel{display:none;background:#fff;max-height:70vh;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:0 0 var(--r-lg) var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--sh-3);position:relative;z-index:2}
.mobile-panel.open{display:block}
.mobile-panel ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:6px 0 22px}
.mobile-panel li{margin:0}
.mobile-panel a{display:block;padding:13px var(--gut);font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.mobile-panel a.sub{padding-left:calc(var(--gut) + 20px);font-weight:400;font-family:var(--ff-body);color:var(--body);font-size:.95rem}
.mobile-panel a:hover{background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy)}
.mobile-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:18px var(--gut) 8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mobile-actions .btn{flex:1 1 170px}
@media (max-width:1399px){.nav-list>li>a,.nav-toggle-sub{padding:11px 8px;font-size:.9rem}.nav-list>li>a::after,.nav-toggle-sub::after{left:8px;right:8px}}
/* the utility strip scrolls away; only the main bar stays pinned */
@media (max-width:860px){.site-header{top:-46px}}
@media (max-width:1279px){.nav-main{display:none}.burger{display:inline-flex}.hdr-cta .btn-quote-hdr{display:none}}
@media (max-width:640px){.hdr{gap:10px}.brand img{width:150px}.hdr-cta .btn-call-hdr{display:none}.call-icon{display:inline-flex}}

/* ---------- hero: full-bleed media, overlay, display type ---------- */
.hero{position:relative;background:var(--navy-900);color:var(--d-body);--hdr-bar:111px;margin-top:calc(var(--hdr-bar) * -1);padding-top:var(--hdr-bar);isolation:isolate}
.hero .media{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;margin:0}
.hero .fig{margin:0;border-radius:0;height:100%;background:var(--navy-800);box-shadow:none}
.hero .fig picture{display:block;height:100%}
.hero .fig img{width:100%;height:100%;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:cover;object-position:56% 50%;filter:brightness(1.08) saturate(1.06) contrast(1.03)}
.hero .media::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:
  linear-gradient(94deg,rgba(10,16,30,.95) 0%,rgba(10,16,30,.88) 36%,rgba(10,16,30,.6) 62%,rgba(10,16,30,.5) 100%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,16,30,.8) 0%,transparent 28%,rgba(10,16,30,.55) 100%)}
.hero .fig figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:var(--gut);bottom:clamp(104px,11vw,150px);width:min(380px,calc(100% - var(--gut)*2));
  font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:.73rem;line-height:1.55;padding:14px 17px;border-radius:var(--r);
  background:rgba(10,16,30,.76);color:#cfd9ec;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.17);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.hero .fig figcaption b{color:#fff;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}
.hero .fig figcaption em{display:block;font-style:normal;color:#aab8d4;margin-top:6px}
.hero .wrap{position:static}
.hero-grid>div:first-child{position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(0,352px);gap:clamp(28px,4vw,56px);align-items:center;padding-block:clamp(40px,4.4vw,66px) clamp(96px,9vw,128px);min-height:min(48vh,430px)}
.hero h1{color:#fff;margin-bottom:.46em;max-width:24ch}
.hero .eyebrow{color:#fff}
.hero .eyebrow::before{background:var(--red);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 99px var(--red)}
.hero-lede{color:#d2dcf0;font-size:clamp(1.02rem,1.3vw,1.17rem);max-width:52ch}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:13px;margin:32px 0 24px}
.hero-note{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;font-size:.93rem;color:#dbe4f4;margin:0;font-weight:500}
.hero-note .ic{width:22px;height:22px;padding:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-sizing:border-box}

/* proof strip: white panel riding the hero edge */
.proof{position:relative;z-index:4;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);list-style:none;margin:0 0 calc(var(--panel-drop) * -1);padding:0;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--sh-3);overflow:hidden;--panel-drop:clamp(38px,5vw,64px);transform:translateY(var(--panel-drop))}
.proof li{margin:0;padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) clamp(16px,2vw,30px);display:flex;gap:.8em;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.proof li:first-child{border-left:0}
.proof .ic-md{color:#fff;background:var(--navy);border-radius:50%;padding:7px;width:34px;height:34px;box-sizing:border-box;margin-top:1px}
.proof li:nth-child(2) .ic-md,.proof li:nth-child(4) .ic-md{background:var(--red)}
.proof b{display:block;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-size:1.06rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:2px;letter-spacing:0}
.after-hero{padding-top:calc(var(--band) + clamp(38px,5vw,64px))}

/* ---------- bands ---------- */
.b-wash{background:var(--paper-2)}
.b-tint{background:var(--navy-50)}
.b-enquire{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(176deg,#ffffff 0%,#eef2f9 46%,#e4eaf5 100%)}
.b-enquire::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 100% 0%,rgba(203,66,54,.09),transparent 62%),
             radial-gradient(48% 56% at 0% 100%,rgba(32,56,110,.09),transparent 64%)}
.b-enquire>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.b-enquire .form-card{box-shadow:0 40px 90px -34px rgba(13,20,38,.42)}
.b-navy{background:var(--navy-900);color:var(--d-body);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.b-navy{background:linear-gradient(168deg,#16213c 0%,#0d1426 62%,#0b1120 100%)}
.b-navy::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(70% 86% at 86% 4%,rgba(43,74,140,.42),transparent 64%)}
.b-navy>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.b-navy h2,.b-navy h3{color:#fff}
.b-navy .lede,.b-navy p{color:var(--d-body)}
.b-navy .eyebrow{color:#fff}
.b-round{border-radius:var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) 0 0}
.b-round-b{border-radius:0 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl)}

/* ---------- service panels ---------- */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:clamp(16px,1.7vw,24px)}
.svc{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:clamp(26px,2.6vw,38px);text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease),transform var(--t) var(--ease)}
.svc::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto auto 0 0;width:100%;height:4px;background:var(--red);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform var(--t-slow) var(--ease)}
.svc:hover{border-color:transparent;box-shadow:var(--sh-2);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.svc:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.svc .badge{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:22px;transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.svc .badge svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.svc:hover .badge{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.svc h3{margin-bottom:.45em;font-size:clamp(1.12rem,1.5vw,1.32rem)}
.svc p{font-size:.96rem;color:var(--body);margin-bottom:1.2em}
.svc .more{margin-top:auto;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.93rem;color:var(--navy);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em}
.svc .more .ic{width:28px;height:28px;padding:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy);box-sizing:border-box;transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease),background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.svc:hover .more{color:var(--red-700)}
.svc:hover .more .ic{background:var(--red);color:#fff;transform:rotate(-45deg)}

/* ---------- split ---------- */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.02fr) minmax(0,.98fr);gap:clamp(32px,4.6vw,78px);align-items:center}
.split-copy>p:last-of-type{margin-bottom:1.6em}
.media{position:relative}
.fig{position:relative;z-index:1;margin:0;border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;background:var(--navy-800);box-shadow:var(--sh-3)}
.fig img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/11;object-fit:cover}
.fig.sq img{aspect-ratio:1/1}
.fig.wide img{aspect-ratio:16/9}
.fig figcaption{font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.55;padding:13px 17px;background:var(--paper-3);color:#5b657a;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.fig figcaption b{color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;display:block;font-size:.73rem;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
.fig figcaption em{display:block;font-style:normal;color:var(--body);margin-top:5px}
@media (min-width:1040px){
  .hero .media::before{content:none}

  border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.84rem;margin-bottom:14px}
.shws-repairs .svc-steps li:nth-child(even)::before{background:var(--navy-600)}
.shws-repairs .svc-steps h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;color:#fff}
.shws-repairs .svc-steps p{margin:0;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.62;color:var(--d-body)}

/* brands */
.shws-repairs .svc-brands{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(190px,100%),1fr))}
.shws-repairs .svc-brands li{margin:0}
.shws-repairs .svc-brands a{display:block;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px 18px;
  text-decoration:none;transition:border-color var(--t) var(--ease),transform var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease)}
.shws-repairs .svc-brands a:hover{border-color:var(--red);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--sh-2)}
.shws-repairs .svc-brands b{display:block;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.04rem;color:var(--ink)}
.shws-repairs .svc-brands span{display:block;font-size:.83rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}

/* ---- sticky rail ---- */
.shws-repairs .svc-rail{min-width:0;align-self:stretch}
.shws-repairs .svc-rail-inner{position:sticky;top:clamp(96px,11vh,128px);display:grid;gap:14px}
@media (max-width:1040px){.shws-repairs .svc-rail-inner{position:static;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(260px,100%),1fr))}}
.shws-repairs .rail-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);box-shadow:var(--sh-1)}
.shws-repairs .rail-k{margin:0 0 10px;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy)}
.shws-repairs .rail-lede{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.62}
.shws-repairs .rail-btn{width:100%;min-height:54px}
.shws-repairs .rail-btn+.rail-btn{margin-top:10px}
.shws-repairs .rail-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;margin:14px 0 0;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}
.shws-repairs .rail-note .ic{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;color:var(--red)}

.shws-repairs .rail-cta{background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--navy-50) 0%,#ffffff 62%);border-color:var(--line-2)}

.shws-repairs .rail-nav ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav li{margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav li:first-child{border-top:0}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:11px 0;
  font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;
  transition:color var(--t) var(--ease),padding-left var(--t) var(--ease)}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:2px solid var(--navy-300);border-top:2px solid var(--navy-300);
  transform:rotate(45deg);flex:none;transition:border-color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a:hover{color:var(--red-700);padding-left:5px}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a:hover::after{border-color:var(--red)}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--navy);position:relative;padding-left:14px}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a[aria-current="page"]::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:4px;height:18px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--red)}
.shws-repairs .rail-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after{border-color:var(--red)}

.shws-repairs .rail-why .buy-trust{margin:0;padding:0;border-top:0}
.shws-repairs .rail-shop .rail-btn{margin-bottom:0}

/* ---- enquiry band: copy on the left, the systems line-up on the right ---- */
.shws-repairs .enq-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:clamp(20px,3vw,56px);
  align-items:center}
@media (max-width:900px){.shws-repairs .enq-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.shws-repairs .enq-copy{min-width:0}
.shws-repairs .enq-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:0 0 clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px)}
.shws-repairs .enq-systems{margin:0;justify-self:center;max-width:min(500px,100%);width:100%;position:relative}
.shws-repairs .enq-systems::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:2%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:84%;aspect-ratio:1/.22;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 55%,rgba(32,56,110,.17) 0%,rgba(32,56,110,0) 72%)}
.shws-repairs .enq-systems img{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
@media (max-width:900px){.shws-repairs .enq-systems{max-width:380px;margin-top:8px}}
